Rocky Road Turtle Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 27, 2009 - 11:18pm

Ingredients




1 German chocolate cake mix
1 pkg. caramels
1/2 cup condensed milk
2 cups marshmallows
1 sm. pkg. chocolate chips
1 cup chopped pecans
1 pkg. instant chocolate pudding

Preparation

1 Follow cake recipe on cake mix and add pudding - put half cake mix in 10 x 13 inch pan. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes. Melt caramels with milk, put on top of cake then add chocolate chips, nuts and marshmallows. Then put remaining cake mix on top. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.
